excerpts.author: arwer13
excerpts.content:
Hello! I've got a question about withdrawals-devnet-3
It has block gas limit `0x400000 (=4,194,304)`. Why so?
It causes that e. g. some of Aragon contracts cannot be deployed (they require 5m+ gas per tx)
Could it be changed in future devenets? Would it be different in the first withdrawals public testnet?

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: Yeah probably an oversight, we will make sure to increase the gas limit in future devnets

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: The gas limit should be slowly increasing though

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: So you might be able to deploy soon

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: Hmm, my latest block has gas limit 20347473

excerpts.content: I actually like that we're exercising this part of the code, so we should maybe start with a 25M gas limit in the genesis tool
